The estimates are geometric box proxies in the calibrated floor, not validated anatomical or behavioral measurements.
Scientific metric eligibility and the original metrics.csv export remain unchanged. Estimated results have a separate policy and JSON export.
Browser used generic fixtures, a placeholder MP4 and mocked native commands; no installed-app or remote Colab/GPU validation.
Zero observed movement and missing usable data remain distinct. Missing intervals are not filled.
No commit, push, deployment or tracking rerun.
